column1: # Worker pool: complexity tier -> workers in preference order (tab-separated).
# route-model-task chooses the tier; pool.sh drops workers that cannot take the task now.
# Override the whole table with MMO_POOL_TIERS=<file> in the same format.
# Mistral Large 4 is worker-only and last in its tier. Review skips vibe.
# Older-generation rows stay behind the current ones as fallbacks; public evidence, overridden by contradicting local records, sets the order.
